authorization: Owner decision 2026-11-04: simplify the live path to match the approved grade-led-leader-weight/3 contract — stop requiring the monthly holding model, timing publication and residual month for the grade-led leader policy, keep the installed risk bank and report validation, and install through a new release.
comparative_performance: No economic change. The leader sizing arithmetic and every parameter are identical to the installed grade-led-leader-weight/3 release: entry at A or better, held while A, exit below A, 1% minimum trade, 63-session leader tilt 0.5, EWMA-20 volatility target 0.25 with exposure floor 0.5, 25% per-name cap, P/E-history tilt off, next-open execution. The only change is the live input binding: the leader path reads the authenticated nightly report and the installed risk bank instead of the learned monthly generation that expired on 2026-11-01 and cannot be refitted locally. The /3 forward record has zero completed sessions; the first ordinary nightly after deploy starts it. The current-code honest-universe readings remain those recorded at the /3 install: 13.28% CAGR, -34.39% median drawdown, -39.42% worst drawdown, 0.816 Sharpe and 8.44x annual turnover at 25 bp, 20 offsets. The candidate still fails the program objective; this release is a correctness repair, not new economic evidence.
contract: grade-led-leader-weight/3 (revision 8: entry at A, hold while A, exit below A, 1% minimum trade, 63-session leader tilt 0.5, EWMA-20 volatility target 0.25 with exposure floor 0.5, 25% per-name cap, P/E-history sizing tilt removed); the leader live path binds the authenticated nightly report and the installed risk bank's calendar prefix and symbol universe, keeps the installed timing configuration hash and the paper-broker guards, and never reads the learned monthly holding model, execution publication or residual month; valuation analyst at three votes; FOMC pre-meeting cut retired 2026-10-28 (fomc-hold-through-meeting/1), full exposure through meetings; an unknown FOMC calendar no longer blocks ordinary planning while retired; a cycle already open still restores at the decision-day close
execution: every leg a market-on-open order at the nightly (revision 1); EWMA-20 volatility estimate (revision 2); entry at A or better, held while A, exit below A (revision 7); resizes under 1% of equity not traded, exits always (revision 5); P/E-history tilt removed (revision 8); no FOMC reduction is planned after 2026-10-28; the open 2026-10-28 cycle restores on the decision session's 3:45 PM candle (decision_close), and a cycle finished on the decision night hands the account back to the ordinary plan the same night; the market-open submission guard reads the reviewed regular XNYS session, not the broker's extended-hours flag
